summary: M&T Bank Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 22, 2026, announcing the refresh of its Medium-Term Note Program. Under the program, the company may issue Senior Medium-Term Notes, Series C, and Subordinated Medium-Term Notes, Series D, from time to time. The notes are registered under the Securities Act via a Form S-3 shelf registration. No specific issuance terms, such as principal amount, interest rate, or maturity, were disclosed. The filing includes a distribution agreement with RBC Capital Markets and other agents, along with officers' certificates and specimen notes. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
